title: termal_list_sessions lost status and preview after the 0fb7b034 restart (federated shape), blinding coordinators
outcome: termal_list_sessions again lets a coordinator see each session's working or idle status and current preview, as it did before 0fb7b034, alongside the new federated identity fields.
acceptance: Domain MCP rows with an exact existing root-summary match expose agent, status, workdir and preview equal to the existing listing projection, plus projectId from the same exact summary or null if unknown; all P0 identity, address, wake fields and root filtering remain unchanged.

Duplicate bare native ids across hosts cannot cross-attribute metadata. Absent or unavailable metadata is explicitly unknown; standalone and unavailable-directory fallback retain their current metadata. No new endpoint, request fan-out, poller, cache, protocol or persistent-directory change is introduced.

One focused regression run using the existing bridge fixture proves qualified metadata retention and collision/unknown behavior while keeping the relevant directory/native-addressing controls. The final input receives one independent Codex/Claude review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium or higher finding and one complete READY handoff to the integration owner.
